Card Q&A.a: 1 [Hybrid] trait Digimon card and 1 red Tamer card.
Card Q&A.q: What cards are added to my hand by this card's [On Play] effect?

Effect: [On Play] Reveal the top 3 cards of your deck. Add 1 Digimon card with [Hybrid] in its form and/or 1 red Tamer card among them to your hand. Place the remaining cards at the bottom of your deck in any order.
